summary: A discussion of the print file type in the ARPANET File Transfer Protocol, written before an FTP meeting. It reviews how vertical format control for printed output should be treated, and how the Remote Job Entry protocol seemed to force one particular interpretation. It updates RFC 354, 385 and 454.

eli5.summary: Some files are meant to be printed on paper, with page breaks and line spacing. People disagreed about how to handle those when sending files.
